title: A tidier hero panel and item cards
changes: The Character, Inventory and Skills panel is narrower and has a bronze frame. Your stats show once, on the Character tab, with colours, and each attribute says in one line what a point gives you.
Inventory: worn gear shows icons only (a red frame means the piece does nothing for you), empty slots show a faint icon, and the loot filter hides behind the cog button.
Pointing at an item, in your bag, on your hero or in a shop, shows a card beside the panel with its details and what it would change: green for better, red for worse.
Skills: one short hint line instead of three, and the skill details fit the panel on small screens.
